title: dq-kernel profile
description: A profile of one dataset, dq-profile/v1, as dq-profile writes it: a bounded summary whose size depends on the column count alone, with one entry per column. Its shape is stated here. What a shape cannot say is enforced where it is read, in dq/profile/profile.py: which measures a type has (a bound only for a type with an order, a length only for text and binary, a precision and a scale only for a decimal, a not-a-number count only for a float), that bounds come in pairs, and that a least value is not above its greatest. A reader refuses a key or a version it does not know rather than misread it, so anything added here is a new version.

snapshot_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the bytes the profiler read, where it read them from files: a file's own, or every file of a directory in name order. Null for a profile taken through the Python API, which read no files.

rows.description: How many rows the dataset holds.

columns.description: One entry per column, in the dataset's order. A dataset that names a column twice is not profiled.

column.description: One column's summary. Every key is always present: a measure the column's type has no meaning for is null, never omitted, so a reader never has to tell absence from none.

name.description: The column's name: not blank, whatever characters it holds.

type.description: The column's type in the profile's words, whatever engine spelled it. A nested column, and one of a type the profile does not know, is counted for nulls and nothing more.

nulls.description: How many values are SQL nulls. A float that is not a number is a value.

distinct.description: How many values are distinct, nulls left out; null where the profiler does not count them.

distinct_exact.description: Whether the distinct count is exact.

min.description: The least value, spelled as its type spells it: an integer, a float, the text of a decimal, a date as YYYY-MM-DD, a timestamp as ISO 8601 without an offset. Null where the type has no order or every value is null. A float that is not a number is never a bound; an infinite one is spelled "Infinity" or "-Infinity".

max.description: The greatest value, spelled as min is.

min_length.description: The least length of a text or binary value; null for every other type.

max_length.description: The greatest length of a text or binary value; null for every other type.

precision.description: A decimal's precision; null for every other type.

scale.description: A decimal's scale, which may be negative; null for every other type.

not_a_number.description: How many values of a float column are not a number; null for every other type.

bound.description: Null, or a value as its type spells it. A type listed, not alternatives: an integer is a number too, and would match two.
